title: Pan-Seared Pork Chops with American Glaze
description: A classic American recipe featuring tender pork chops smothered in a sweet and sticky glaze, served with a side of roasted vegetables. This dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner or special occasion.
instructions: Season the pork chops with salt and black pepper.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork chops for 2-3 minutes per side, or until browned and cooked to an internal temperature of 145°F.
Transfer the pork chops to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
Reduce heat to medium and add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet.
Add the brown sugar, honey, Dijon mustard, and apple cider vinegar to the skillet.
Bring the glaze to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until thickened slightly.
Return the pork chops to the skillet and coat with the glaze.
Serve the pork chops hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
